newsitem.title: USA: Brazos Block natgas find seen in production soon.
newsitem.headline: Brazos Block natgas find seen in production soon.

text.p: Seagull Energy Corp said Wednesday a new fault block natural gas discovery well on Brazos Block 552 in the Gulf of Mexico will be linked to existing facilities and begin producing before the end of March.

Seagull said the well encountered 86 cumulative feet of productive natural gas sands in six zones. Tests conducted during the course of completion operations in two of the six zones yielded natural gas flows totaling 4.8 million cubic feet per day.
Seagull said it holds a 17.5 percent working interest in the discovery well, which is located about 62 miles southwest of Freeport, Texas in 78 feet of water.

The remaining interests are held by Noble Affiliates Inc , 32.5 percent; Case-Pomeroy Oil Corp, 24.35 percent; Mitchell Energy & Development Corp and Ashland Exploration Inc, recently renamed Blazer Energy Corp, each with 8.77 percent; and Holly Corp, 8.1 percent.
